variables.helpIntro: Write a placeholder wherever you need the value; it is replaced right before the request is sent. Syntax:
helpWhere: Request body (JSON, text and form fields)
Auth: bearer token, basic user/password, API key name and value
variables.helpRules: Names accept letters, digits and underscores. An undefined name is sent literally, exactly as typed.
variables.helpPrecedence: Precedence: the active environment wins over folder variables, and a nested folder overrides its parents. A folder variable can hold one value per environment, plus a default shared by all of them.
variables.helpAutocomplete: Type {{ or press Ctrl/Cmd+Space to autocomplete a name.
variables.captureHelpIntro: The path walks the JSON response body: object keys separated by dots, array positions as a number (zero-based), either bare or in brackets.
variables.captureHelpStored: The value is stored as a variable in the active environment, so later requests can use it as {{name}}. Objects and arrays are stored as JSON.
variables.captureHelpRules: Captures only run on 2xx responses with a JSON body. A path that does not exist leaves the previous value untouched.
